8-Day Classic Morocco Tour: Four Imperial Cities
summary:
The 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour follows a small-group route from Marrakech through Morocco’s Atlantic cities, imperial centers and desert regions. Visit Essaouira, Casablanca, Rabat, Fez and Roman Volubilis before the journey turns south through Erfoud, Todra Gorge, Zagora and Ouarzazate. Ten nights allow these contrasting regions to be explored within one organized overland circuit.
Guaranteed departures operate every Friday, with deluxe coach transportation connecting the route and carefully selected hotels used throughout the journey. While the core 11-day program follows a scheduled small-group format, private pre- and post-tour extensions can be customized around your arrival plans, interests or additional destinations in Morocco.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Casablanca.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Fes (300 km)
itinerary.text: Explore Casablanca, Morocco’s economic capital. Visit the Habous District, Royal Palace, Mohammed V Square, and the Anfa residential area. See the exterior of the Hassan II Mosque. Optional lunch during the tour before continuing to Fez. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez sightseeing
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Fez, Morocco’s spiritual capital. Explore the Medieval Medina and traditional souks. Visit the Royal Palace of Fez, Bou Inania Madrasa or Attarine Medersa, and the Nejjarine Fountain. See the exterior of the University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Optional lunch, dinner,, Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez, Volubilis, Meknes, Rabat (260km)
itinerary.text: Stop for a panoramic view of Moulay Idriss Zerhoun and visit the Roman ruins of Volubilis. Continue to Meknes, the Ismaili capital of Morocco. Optional lunch during the tour. Visit Bab Mansour, the Royal Stables, and the Jewish Quarter before continuing to Rabat. Overnight in Rabat.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Marrakech (330km)
itinerary.text: Explore Rabat, the administrative capital of Morocco. Visit the Royal Palace of Rabat (Mechouar), Kasbah of the Udayas and its gardens, and the Hassan Tower. Optional lunch during the tour before continuing to Marrakech via highway. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech, known as the “Ochre City.” Visit the Menara Gardens, Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and Dar Si Said Museum. Optional lunch during the tour. Explore the traditional souks and handicraft quarters before visiting the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its lively entertainment. Optional dinner with traditional show. Overnight in Marrakech

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Agafay
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to the stone desert of Agafay Desert. Optional lunch during the tour. Optional activities including camel ride and quad biking are available. Dinner, Overnight under a desert tent in Agafay Desert.

itinerary.title: Agafay Marrakech Departure
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check-out
Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport for your return flight home

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Morocco Vacation Package – 8 Days?
faqs.a: The Morocco Vacation Package – 8 Days covers Casablanca, Rabat, Fez, and Marrakech. This itinerary takes travelers through Morocco's most famous imperial cities, offering a perfect blend of history, culture, architecture, and authentic Moroccan experiences. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Morocco Vacation Package – 8 Days cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,675 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the journey. Comfortable vehicles are used for transfers and sightseeing, ensuring a convenient and enjoyable travel experience between destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to explore Morocco's most important cultural and historical destinations. It provides an excellent introduction to the country's imperial cities and rich heritage.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, historical sites, local markets, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Casablanca, Rabat, Fez, and Marrakech?
faqs.a: Casablanca is home to the magnificent Hassan II Mosque and Morocco's modern commercial center. Rabat offers beautiful historical monuments and coastal charm as the nation's capital. Fez is famous for its UNESCO-listed medieval medina, traditional craftsmanship, and ancient universities. Marrakech captivates visitors with its colorful souks, palaces, gardens, and lively Jemaa el-Fnaa Square.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Morocco Vacation Package – 8 Days?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Morocco Vacation Package – 8 Days be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include Chefchaouen, Essaouira, or a Sahara Desert extension, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
